notablePrerequisites: You have at least four creature cards in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Izoni, adding {1}.
Izoni dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Izoni from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Izoni enters the battlefield, creating at least four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Insects, adding {3}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite creature tokens and mana, you can use that to activate Izoni's ability to draw infinite cards.
